name: Vivien Reid
description: Vivien Reid is a hunter and planeswalker from Skalla, its last survivor, who wields the Arkbow and protects wild animals and nature.

timeline.summary: On Ixalan, Vivien intervenes against the Baron of Vernot, is captured and tortured, escapes, kills the Baron, and frees and enlarges the menagerie, destroying Luneau.
timeline.quote: Vivien killed the Baron by firing the spirit of the monstrosaur at him.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "On Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas destroyed Vivien's world, so she celebrates all life in honor of Skalla.
timeline.quote: "Nicol Bolas destroyed my world.

citation.text: Bristling Boar (Core Set 2019, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vivien, aboard Frederic's ship, refuses to stow the Arkbow and expresses concern over the brontodon captive.
timeline.quote: There will be medical attention waiting for the brontodon, I hope?

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: At the pier Vivien pins a human pickpocket who offers blood as penance, and Frederic offers her a dirk to take it.
timeline.quote: This is the currency of Luneau, mademoiselle.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien refuses the blood and frees the pickpocket, accusing Luneau of being a glorified abattoir.
timeline.quote: I'd say you were bullying this boy into accepting his lot as livestock

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Frederic claims Luneau preserves species, and Vivien tours the marble city with disgust.
timeline.quote: Preservation, mademoiselle. You never know when a species might go extinct.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Frederic touches Vivien's wrist and asks about her home, and she recalls Skalla's destruction by fire.
timeline.quote: She tried not to think of fire.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the Hall of Treasures Vivien sees hundreds of taxidermied extinct species and wants to see it all gone, understanding Bolas for a moment.
timeline.quote: For one terrible moment, the Planeswalker could understand Nicol Bolas, the death of Skalla, the end of everything she'd known and loved.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: In the Perfumed Court, Frederic tells Vivien that the Baron of Vernot believes there are giants among the lizards, and the Arkbow urges Vivien to destroy Luneau, though she decides to wait.
timeline.quote: The Arkbow loathed this place.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: King Lucard and Queen Salazar enter and the court bows, but Vivien stays unbowed.
timeline.quote: Alone of them, Vivien stood unbowed, chin tipped up.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: The Baron of Vernot, Marcois Jean-Jaquent, enters and calls his special guests.
timeline.quote: We are ready for you.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: At the Tourdion, performers torture lizards, bears, raptors and cranes, and Vivien protests.
timeline.quote: This is cruelty,

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: The baron presents a new monstrosaur, tortured and with its largest teeth plucked.
timeline.quote: Someone, Vivien realized with a pang of horror, had plucked the largest teeth from its head.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien fires the Arkbow, summoning a spectral hydra that kills nobles and disrupts the gala.
timeline.quote: the seething, glimmering green outline of a hydra wrenched itself from the arrowhead and howled its hunger for the world to see.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien summons a Pelakka wurm that devours guards and a spectral stag that throws a guard into a wall.
timeline.quote: The Pelakka wurm launched itself forward, all mouth and sinuous body, glowing green.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: The Baron of Vernot confronts Vivien surrounded by crossbowmen, and Vivien calls the place an abomination.
timeline.quote: This place is an abomination.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien vows to make Luneau pay and summons a swarm of giant wasps.
timeline.quote: I will see Luneau pay for what it has done to this world.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien stabs the baron with her daggers but he is unharmed, and he backhands her.
timeline.quote: But the baron's placid expression did not change.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien kicks and clubs the baron, but his minions drag her away; she knocks out two guards before losing consciousness.
timeline.quote: It was, she decided as awareness bled from her, at least a decent last stand.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 1" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien wakes, bloodied and suspended in manacles, as the Baron of Vernot tells her he has taken her Arkbow.
timeline.quote: We took your bow.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: The baron describes his failed attempts to use the Arkbow and questions what Vivien is, speculating she is a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: I wonder if you are a Planeswalker.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien demands the Arkbow back; the baron refuses and presses her on how it works, and she mentions Skalla.
timeline.quote: Return the Arkbow.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: The baron tortures Vivien repeatedly with boiling-blood magic and blades, and nuns heal her each time; Vivien resists, having already been scarred by Bolas's destruction of Skalla.
timeline.quote: Each time he asked his questions, the baron's magic reached out, found the blood coursing through Vivien's body, and brought it to boil.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: The nuns bathe Vivien, dress her in a penitent's gown, chain her and lead her through the underground corridors toward the baron's luxurious quarters.
timeline.quote: But she said nothing, silent as the nuns laced her wrists with filigree chains

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien is locked in a lavish cell with a table of fruit, trapped again.
timeline.quote: She was trapped, again.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Vivien relives the death of Skalla and Nicol Bolas rising into the burning sky, even in her dreams.
timeline.quote: When Vivien slumbered, she dreamed Skalla.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: A guard fetches Vivien, saying the baron has something to ask her, and she accepts rather than endure more stillness.
timeline.quote: Death, at that moment, appealed more than the continued ennui.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien is brought to a ballroom where the baron vivisects a living monstrosaur before King Lucard and his courtiers.
timeline.quote: He was, Vivien realized with a dazed start, not performing an autopsy, but a vivisection.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: The baron reveals he has deduced Skalla is dead and Vivien is its last living relic, and offers her glories and a queen's place if she teaches him to use the Arkbow.
timeline.quote: Teach me how to make use of the weapon and we will garland you with glories, ensure that you are never with an unfulfilled desire.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien feigns capitulation, agreeing to show the baron the Arkbow's mechanism but insisting she needs the weapon and that only she can perform the ritual.
timeline.quote: You can try all you want, but it won't work unless I'm performing the ritual.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien needles the baron until his composure cracks, declares she does not fear him but he fears her, and signals King Lucard, whose lady-in-waiting begins to bring a drink.
timeline.quote: But I think I scare you.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 2" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien reflects that her description of how the Arkbow works was true, and that she is the last of Skalla who can perform the ritual.
timeline.quote: But now Vivien was the last of Skalla.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: The baron's minions assemble a containment contraption around the dying monstrosaur and the nuns conjure a barrier; Vivien steps inside.
timeline.quote: More of the nuns were called to the room, and humming a couplet of chords, they conjured a shimmering barrier.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien demands anesthetics for the monstrosaur, and the nuns numb it into a deep sleep at the baron's order.
timeline.quote: The nuns complied.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien performs the ritual: the Arkbow opens and she draws the monstrosaur's spirit into it.
timeline.quote: The monstrosaur did not resist.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: The baron makes a guard try the Arkbow; it bursts his body, proving it obeys only Vivien, and the baron refuses to accept it.
timeline.quote: A minute spasm of those meaty digits, and his body burst outward.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien grows a spider from the guard's pocket with her magic and it leaps at King Lucard, causing chaos and loosening the nuns' hold on her prison.
timeline.quote: Alarmed by its growth, the arachnid turned and launched itself at the king.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien looses an arrow that summons the monstrosaur whole and vengeful, and it rampages through the ballroom, tearing through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: The arrow buried itself in the wall, and the ethereal monstrosaur tore itself loose, roaring

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien follows the monstrosaur through the palace and enlarges and frees the animals of the Royal Menagerie, who attack their handlers.
timeline.quote: Vivien ran her magic through a family of wildebeests, stoking their cells until the creatures grew large enough to smash through their confinement.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: In a gallery of nobles, Vivien declares the end of Luneau and enlarges a vampire girl's pet raptor, which devours its owner.
timeline.quote: Then, without any reservation, it twitched forward and shut its jaws around the vampire's skull, teeth crunching through the vertebrae.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Enormous dinosaurs and beasts flood Luneau's streets, wrecking buildings, as Vivien rides a monstrosaur's head.
timeline.quote: these creatures weren't just unexpectedly everywhere, they were each three times their usual sizes, too massive to be plausible.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien surveys the anarchy she unleashed and resolves to secure the Arkbow against theft and find larger prey to hunt.
timeline.quote: Vivien wouldn't tolerate an encore.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien decides to harness dragons to learn the secret of destroying Nicol Bolas, and settles on luring a Shivan dragon.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas wasn't the only dragon in the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Vivien planeswalks from Ixalan to Shiv.
timeline.quote: before she flashed into the next plane and felt the hard, hot air of Shiv on her skin

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien try to assassinate Liliana and nearly succeed until Bolas destroys the buildings and saves her; Teferi saves the others.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas destroys Skalla; the Nura and Smaragdi make the Arkbow, but as the forest burns Vivien's spark ignites and she planeswalks away with it.
timeline.quote: Vivien's spark ignited , planeswalking her and the Arkbow to safety.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien is lured to Ravnica and trapped there by the Immortal Sun, hoping to kill Bolas for Skalla's destruction.
timeline.quote: Seeking revenge for Skalla's destruction, she hoped to personally kill Bolas.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien and Samut insist surrender to Bolas is not an option.
timeline.quote: Vivien and Samut insisted that surrender was not an option

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien, Jace, Jaya and Teferi nearly assassinate Liliana, but Bolas saves her by destroying the buildings.
timeline.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien stays on Ravnica to help the Gatewatch after the Immortal Sun is disabled and survives the battle.
timeline.quote: She survived the battle and was present during the Planewide Celebration that followed.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien Reid meets the sage Rielle at Lake Attayal.
timeline.quote: This is also the site where Vivien Reid encountered Rielle

citation.text: "Ketria", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien arrives in Luneau aboard a ship carrying a captured juvenile brontodon, accompanied by the vampire huntsman Frederic.
timeline.quote: Vivien Reid travelled to Luneau aboard a ship transporting a captured juvenile brontodon

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien learns that Luneau uses blood as currency and treats humans as livestock for its Legion of Dusk rulers.
timeline.quote: Vivien learned that the city relied on blood as currency

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At a gala, Vivien sees captive beasts tortured for the nobles' entertainment and summons a hydra, wurm and stag with her Arkbow to disrupt it, freeing a mutilated monstrosaur and escaping.
timeline.quote: Vivien used her Arkbow to summon a hydra

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien is captured and tortured by the Baron of Vernot, who has stolen her Arkbow; she refuses to reveal its secrets.
timeline.quote: The Baron had stolen Vivien's Arkbow

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Baron moves Vivien to a gilded prison where she remains in magical stasis, reliving the loss of Skalla and her defeat by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Later, the Baron moved her to a gilded prison

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Baron summons Vivien to witness a monstrosaur's vivisection and demands she teach him to use the Arkbow; she feigns cooperation and asserts that the power is hers.
timeline.quote: The Baron summoned Vivien to witness the vivisection of a monstrosaur

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Forced to perform the ritual, Vivien lets the Arkbow reject the Baron's guard, enlarges a spider to disrupt her prison and unleashes a dying monstrosaur's essence, which kills the Baron.
timeline.quote: The Baron was killed by the monstrosaur

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien releases the Royal Menagerie's beasts, which overrun the city and kill or scatter the vampire rulers while humans rejoice.
timeline.quote: The vampire rulers were killed or scattered as the wild reclaimed Luneau City.

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien planeswalks away to seek the dragons of Shiv, leaving Luneau to the beasts and humans.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away, leaving Luneau to the beasts and humans.

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Abda and Rigi meet Brin, Lukka and Vivien Reid north of Drannith; Abda greets Lukka with hostility.
timeline.quote: greeted him with hostility and warned of the dangers posed by urban factions

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph arrive; Vivien says another planeswalker disturbed the Ozolith; Abda agrees to join out of loyalty to Brin.
timeline.quote: because of her loyalty to Brin and concern for the balance of the wilds

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph join a gathering of bonders and allies in the wilds, greeted by Abda, Vivien Reid and Lukka.
timeline.quote: Zeph was immediately recognized as a formidable monster, and his presence drew attention for both his size and power.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After hearing Lukka and Vivien, Barrow becomes convinced action is needed about the Ozolith, and the pair agree to help reach it.
timeline.quote: Barrow and Zeph agreed to assist in the effort to reach the Ozolith and determine the source of its corruption.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow first spots the serpentine nightmares among the Ozolith's crystals and asks the group to be set down.
timeline.quote: it was Barrow who first spotted the serpentine nightmares coiled among the crystals and asked for the group to be set down

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka returns transformed and announces he controls the monsters; Barrow opposes him, saying Zeph is his partner, not a subordinate.
timeline.quote: Lukka announced that he had gained control over the monsters and intended to use this power to support Drannith.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to control Zeph through the Ozolith but fails; Barrow and Zeph flee when Vivien orders the bonders to escape.
timeline.quote: Zeph remained with Barrow as they fled the scene, refusing to submit to Lukka's will

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph travel with Jirina and Vivien back to Drannith by indirect routes, avoiding Lukka's monsters.
timeline.quote: They kept to indirect routes to avoid Lukka's monsters and the city's civilian population

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Citadel war room Barrow, Vivien, Brin and Major Humron join Jirina to plan against Lukka's attack.
timeline.quote: In the Citadel's war room, Barrow, Vivien, Brin, and Major Humron joined her around a map of Drannith to prepare for Lukka's imminent attack.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph lead the bonded charge through the main gate to rescue Jirina, turning the tide until Lukka is surrounded.
timeline.quote: Barrow and Zeph were the first to break through the main gate, leading the charge of bonded fighters to rescue her.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bonders and Vivien arrive at the Ozolith and plan for Lukka to reach the central crystal while the others hold off the nightmares.
timeline.quote: Vivien proposed a plan for him to reach the central crystal while the others held off the defenders

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to seize Zeph and Rol; Vivien hurls him away with her Arkbow and the bonders flee.
timeline.quote: attacked Lukka with her Arkbow

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland meet Lukka and Vivien at a crystal formation on the Egali plains and agree to help reach the Ozolith.
timeline.quote: When Vivien and Lukka proposed joining forces to reach the Ozolith, Brin agreed to help

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to command Roland through the Ozolith; Vivien attacks him, letting Brin and the bonders flee.
timeline.quote: Vivien intervened by attacking Lukka, allowing Brin to flee.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien's summoned monstrosaur turns the battle and the bonders encircle Lukka, ending the assault.

citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Pursuit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien explores New Capenna's lower levels and finds a synthetic city out of balance.
timeline.quote: Nature might exist here, but it wasn't real.

timeline.summary: Vivien recognizes a stranger as a planeswalker, who leads her out of the hall.
timeline.quote: He was also a planeswalker.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien that others like them are present and that his employer is acquiring Halo with other goals, and invites her to meet Urabrask.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien confronts Tezzeret, recalling that they fought on opposite sides in the War of the Spark, and refuses his orders.
timeline.quote: They'd fought on opposite sides during the War of the Spark

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: At a Park Heights drop-off, Elspeth meets the planeswalker Vivien, who promises information on a looming threat.
timeline.quote: "One most certainly is, and we share motivations. I'm Vivien, by the way."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth declines to leave with Vivien, wanting to learn how New Capennans beat the threat; Vivien agrees to contact her later.
timeline.quote: "I'll look further into these matters also and contact you when I have more information."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien follows Tezzeret down through the girders beneath New Capenna, wary of him but trusting her gut.
timeline.quote: Vivien trusted her gut and followed him deeper into the underbelly of this strange, new plane.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: At the bottom of the city Vivien notices the ruins of the first Capenna, with claw marks gouged into the stone.
timeline.quote: These ruins must have been the first Capenna.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals the glowing Planar Bridge in his chest as a show of trust, and admits it corrupted after carrying the praetors.
timeline.quote: "A show of trust and good faith."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
timeline.quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is playing both sides: he needs what Norn promised but does not want life destroyed or himself transformed, and Vivien relaxes.
timeline.quote: He was playing both sides.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
timeline.quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
timeline.quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
timeline.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
timeline.quote: "You have a deal."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien meets her Obscura contact Navy in the Mezzio, trading information about the Font and the Adversary's lounge while hiding what she knows.
timeline.quote: "Not yet, but I'll find out," Vivien lied.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Navy gives Vivien a lead that a woman named Elspeth is taking odd jobs in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: "Oh, I got a lead on your Elspeth character, however."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien sees a woman fight off Maestro enforcers in the street and then watches her give her name to the vampire Anhelo.
timeline.quote: The woman ignored the gesture, continuing to walk before she said, "Elspeth."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien goes to the Adversary's lounge hoping Elspeth will arrive as a Maestro, refuses to drink Halo, and sneaks some into a vial.
timeline.quote: Vivien could sneak some of the Halo out of the lounge and back to Urabrask without arousing suspicion.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien spots Navy slipping out the back and overhears her as a double agent arranging with a Maestro for the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: Navy was a double agent.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien hears a deep, vaguely familiar chuckle from a hidden room revealed in the lounge.
timeline.quote: She heard a deep chuckle echo from the back somewhere.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Navy ambushes Vivien outside the lounge with a dagger, saying the boss does not like people sniffing near his doorstep.
timeline.quote: "And the boss doesn't like people sniffing this close to his doorstep."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien stabs Navy in the gut, tells her to seek the Obscura for help, and takes her notebook.
timeline.quote: with one hand she caught Navy by her forearm.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Using the notebook's note, Vivien waits at a Halo drop-off point in a park for the Maestro collector.
timeline.quote: This was the drop off point for Halo, and the bag was waiting just as the memo said it would be.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien intercepts Elspeth at the drop-off and catches her wrist; Elspeth admits she is learning the plane's history and is there on Ajani's behalf.
timeline.quote: "Ajani sent me."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth says New Capenna might be her home and that she wants to learn how its people beat a threat before.
timeline.quote: "It might be my home."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien declines to bring Elspeth to Urabrask yet, promising to share information when she has more, and leaves.
timeline.quote: "When I have something worthwhile."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "She is the key to our success."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: In the alley, Vivien appears and kills the Adversary's goons with spectral wolves; Elspeth vouches for her to Giada.
timeline.quote: "Vivien's an ally; she can be trusted."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien conjures a spectral dragon to block Jinnie, and the three flee into the night.
timeline.quote: the loops of a scaled dragon filled the alleyway.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urabrask obtains Halo through Vivien Reid.
timeline.quote: Urabrask would establish contact with the planeswalker Vivien Reid and would obtain Halo , a substance that harms Phyrexians.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Urabrask on Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers wait in Liliana's safe house on Dominaria for two weeks of word from the strike team.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: He became one of them,

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: There must be some other way to take the World Tree down.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.quote: I'm not leaving our friends behind.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 2: Holding Your Breath" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Bryd questions trusting Vivien, and Jirina rejects his suspicion; then an attack on the column begins.
timeline.quote: I won't have you discarding one of our strongest on baseless paranoia!

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien and Chevill's hunters prepare an ambush with buried explosives in a canyon, expecting Lukka.
